meta.requirement: Explore Springvale (10%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: tip
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: A New Blacksmith
start.text:
''Near the edge of Springvale, past the last row of farmhouses, you notice a hunched old man seated beside a cold forge. He is staring at a small cloth sack on the ground, worry carved deep into his weathered face.''

Aldric: ''glances up, startled'' Oh. A traveller. Don't mind me, stranger. Just thinking.

wuzwrong.text: Aldric: ''sighs and rubs his callused hands together'' My apprentice. Emre. Bright boy, twenty years old, full of fire in his chest. Yesterday he finally set off for Mondstadt to open his own forge. Seven years I trained him. I should be proud.

soundsgoodnews.text: Aldric: It would be, if the fool hadn't packed so fast he left without a scrap of iron. ''taps the empty cloth sack with his boot'' Without iron, he cannot work. Without work, he cannot eat. And Emre... ''shakes his head slowly'' ...Emre is too proud to come back and ask for any.

choices.label: He doesn't know he left them?

heleftthem.text: Aldric: Oh, he knows by now. He'll have set up his table, reached for the iron, and found nothing but air. But he will sit there and suffer in silence before riding back here to admit a mistake. ''quiet chuckle'' Just like his master used to.

Cant_you_bring_them_yourself.text: Aldric: ''pats his knee with a grimace'' These legs haven't seen Mondstadt in two years, stranger. Two very long years. I'd send a courier, but the boy would know exactly what I was doing. ''pauses'' You, though. You look like someone who was heading that way.

choices.label: I can bring him some iron
That's quite an errand for a stranger

I_can_bring_him_some_iron.text: Aldric: ''rises slowly, with some effort'' His name is Emre. He'll be setting up near the market district. Dark curly hair, probably scowling at an empty worktable. He'll need ten iron chunks before he can do a thing. ''pauses and looks away'' Tell him his master says he did well getting there. Don't mention the iron. Let him think I planned this.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 10 Iron Chunks and deliver them to Emre in Mondstadt

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click Find Emre in the Market District

quite_an_errand.text: Aldric: ''holds your gaze for a moment'' Aye, it is. But Emre won't sleep until he's working. And he won't work until he has iron. ''quietly'' I worry about the boy. That's all.

choices.label: All right. I'll bring him some

emre_mond.text:
''You find him exactly as described. Near the edge of the Mondstadt market district, a young man with dark curly hair and soot-stained hands is staring at a bare worktable, jaw set tight, very clearly trying not to look like someone who has just made a terrible mistake.''

Emre: ''doesn't look up'' We're not open yet.

choices.label: I brought the iron you need
I'll return when I have the iron

Your_master_sent_me.text:
''Emre goes very still. He looks up slowly.''

Emre: ...He did?

''There is something careful about the way he says it. Not quite surprise. More like hope dressed up as a question.''

Emre: Did he send iron too, or just you?

choices.label: I'll gather the iron and return

I_brought_ten_iron_chunks.text:
''You set your iron chunks on the worktable. Emre counts them with his eyes, then looks up at you.''

Emre: ''quietly'' Ten. You actually brought ten.

''He doesn't say anything for a moment.''

Emre: He wouldn't just send iron. He'd say something too. Something he'd never just come out and say to my face. ''looks at you steadily'' What were his exact words?

delivered.title: Delivered
delivered.text:
Emre: ''sets the iron chunk down on the bench. He stares at it for a moment, then rolls up his sleeves.''

Emre: Thank you, traveller. Tell him... tell him the forge is going to be good. He'll know what that means.

''Behind you, the market hum of Mondstadt carries on. In front of you, Emre finally gets to work. The iron chunk rings against the bench as he sets up. It is a good sound.''

just_a_msg.text: Emre: ''nods once, trying not to look disappointed'' Figures. ''crosses his arms'' What's the message, then?

did_well_gtn.text:
''Emre's jaw tightens, though not with pride this time.''

Emre: ...That's it? Seven years and the old man sends a stranger with one sentence. ''looks at the bare worktable'' I still need iron, traveller. Ten chunks, if you're really trying to help.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 10 Iron Chunks and deliver them to Emre in Mondstadt

iron_u_need.text:
''You set your iron chunks on the worktable. Emre counts them with his eyes, then looks up at you.''

Emre: ''quietly'' Ten. You actually brought ten.

''He doesn't say anything for a moment.''

Emre: He wouldn't just send iron. He'd say something too. Something he'd never just come out and say to my face. ''looks at you steadily'' What were his exact words?

You_did_well_getting_here.text:
''Emre laughs. Just once, short and low, like he didn't mean to let it out.''

Emre: Seven years. Seven years and the old man still can't just say it. ''picks up one of the iron chunks and turns it over in his hands'' He sat there with that empty sack every morning, didn't he. Waiting for someone to ride past.

I_will_gather_the_iron_and_return.text:
Emre: ''nods without looking up'' Fine. I'll be here. Don't expect me to smile about it.

''You step away for now. His forge can wait until the iron arrives.''
